title: Convergence analysis and a novel Lagrange multiplier partitioned method for fluid-poroelastic interaction
summary: We propose a partitioned method for the monolithic formulation of the Stokes-Biot system that incorporates Lagrange multipliers enforcing the interface conditions. The monolithic system is discretized using finite elements, and we establish convergence of the resulting approximation. A Schur complement based algorithm is developed together with an efficient preconditioner, enabling the fluid and poroelastic structure subproblems to be decoupled and solved independently at each time step.
